junro.title: Prioritree Birth — the prioritree tree's development setup: foundations, the kumi harness, the governance spine
inputs: the collaborator's rulings of 2026-11-19 (Q-purpose, Q-setup-arch, Q-harness — the purpose, the architecture, the harness depth)
hikari's shared scaffold core (scripts/generation/clarity_scaffold.py — the --target clarity|input family; prioritree joins as --target prioritree)
the kepric-input precedent tree (the most recent scaffolded sibling: /Users/marklosey/projects/kepric/kepric-input)

structure.purpose: The prioritree tree's birth-build — the foundations skeleton (pyproject + uv with the pinned Python, the src/prioritree skeleton + a smoke test, ruff + the ruled type-check config, the pytest floor, .gitignore, README content, the Makefile floor, git hooks — no CI at birth, no DB: pure logic) then the two-tree kumi harness (the third TargetSpec + the prioritree-seats.yaml adapter land in hikari's scripts/generation/; the emission lands in prioritree — opencode.json, AGENTS.md with the ruled goal line, .opencode/ with the fixed five engines and the 13 seat prompts and the pins and the plugin, .githooks/pre-commit — and the friction store's birth) — each unit carrying its own discover → understand → synthesize pipeline before its build dispatch fires
structure.entry_condition: the three birth rulings stand (Q-purpose, Q-setup-arch, Q-harness — ruled 2026-11-19), the composition is validated by the collaborator, and the first unit's dispatch fires — no build dispatch until its unit's brief gate is green (the pipeline law)

steps.input: the ruled brief at G-FOUNDATIONS-BRIEF (the banked exact contents — the exact-task law)
steps.output: pyproject.toml + .python-version + uv.lock + .gitignore + the README content land at the prioritree root (the library-first skeleton; the README carries Q-purpose's ruled description)

the src/prioritree skeleton (the pure-logic core's namespace at the bottom of Q-setup-arch's four-form stack — skeleton only, NO product logic: the core library is the product effort's first increment) + the smoke test land

the ruff config + the type-check config (the checker ruled at Q-typecheck-alignment) + the pytest floor + the Makefile floor (dev/test/lint — the hikari idiom) land; the collaborator's hand sets git config core.hooksPath=.githooks (the no-seat-shelling rule; the .git/config read-back recorded)

steps.tool: make dev && make test && make lint at the prioritree root

steps.input: the discovery's resolved answers riding the pipeline's discover/understand legs (Q-tool-registration's mechanism; the sibling census: the derived-view gitignore shape, the friction store's home and birth mechanism, the emission channel) + the ruled brief at G-HARNESS-BRIEF
steps.output: the third TargetSpec (root=/Users/marklosey/projects/prioritree, the prioritree-seats.yaml adapter, the ruled goal line + its ruling citation, the prioritree law block, PRIORITREE_HOOK_BYPASS) + the prioritree-seats.yaml adapter (the 13 genome seats + the base packs per Q-harness — structural facts only, zero prioritree prose) land in hikari's scripts/generation/; the hikari-side landing rides hikari's shinko-git choreography

steps.tool: uv run python scripts/generation/clarity_scaffold.py --target clarity --check && uv run python scripts/generation/clarity_scaffold.py --target input --check (from hikari's root)
uv run python scripts/generation/clarity_scaffold.py --target prioritree (from hikari's root — the collaborator's regen hand or the brief's ruled channel; no seat shells)
uv run python scripts/generation/clarity_scaffold.py --target prioritree --check (the rot detector — exit 0)

steps.output: the friction store born at prioritree's store home (the discovery-confirmed home + birth mechanism) and the live proof recorded: at least one verbatim fixed-five tool call answering at a prioritree seat (Q-tool-registration resolved BEFORE the emission fired)

structure.purpose: The birth's bookend — the cross-tree records (prioritree's first CONTINUATION.md entry: the birth record; hikari's family-growth line: the five-trees record), the next effort named and born (the product: the core library first), and the done call at the collaborator's ruling

steps.output: the records' content synthesized whole: prioritree's first CONTINUATION.md entry (the birth record — the three rulings, the foundations, the harness, the landing state named honestly: the collaborator's-hand era until prioritree's own landing rule exists) + hikari's family-growth line (the five-trees record) + the next-effort naming (the product: the core library first)

the records landed at both trees: prioritree's CONTINUATION.md committed through the collaborator's hand (the two-tree hands rule — no own landing rule yet); hikari's CONTINUATION.md through hikari's shinko-git choreography; the product effort's store birth recorded (the vitals-store precedent)
the collaborator's close ruling recorded same-turn through the junro and the route's status set done at the ruling

structure.purpose: THE PER-UNIT PIPELINE (engine-stamped, amendment 19): each build unit's discover → understand → synthesize before its build — discover/understand ride ungated packets; the synthesis is the gated increment here closing its own G-<UNIT>-BRIEF; THE PRECEDENCE: no build unit's dispatch fires until its brief gate is green

amendments.what: add-ruling {"question": "Q-purpose", "resolution": "Priori-tree is a generalized prioritization system: for any list and comparison operator, run the pairwise permutations, store the votes, tally — the output list is in a superior order than sizing individual items, because discernment between two items is easy (for humans and LLMs) while absolute sizing is not.", "ruling": "PURPOSE (collaborator ruling 2026-11-19, verbatim): \"Priori-tree is a generalized prioritization system based on the concept that LLM and Humans are great at discerning the difference between two items but not great at sizing an item. That is a simplification. Consider: a human is great at determining that a basketball is larger than a grapefruit. But not great as identifying the exact dimensions of a grapefruit or a basketball. By taking a list and running through the pairwise permutations for any given comparision operator. Storing the votes, then tallying. we get a list out that is in a superior order than trying to size individual items.\" The comparator class is both human AND LLM — both vote through the same vote interface; the tally is a pure function of the stored votes.", "status": "ruled"}
amendments.why: junro route-op provenance stamp (design-spec §6: every route op stamps actor, timestamp, and arguments into the route's amendments)

amendments.what: add-ruling {"question": "Q-setup-arch", "resolution": "All four forms layered library-first: the src/prioritree pure-logic core at the bottom, CLI over it, FastAPI service over that, web app on top — the setup builds the skeleton and the core library is the product effort's first increment. Pure logic at birth (no DB); Makefile floor (dev/test/lint); GitHub project, CI determined later.", "ruling": "SETUP ARCHITECTURE (collaborator ruling 2026-11-19): Primary form = ALL FOUR — Python library, CLI tool, API service (FastAPI), web app — one layered architecture, library-first: src/prioritree carries the pure-logic core (items, comparison operator, pair scheduling, votes, tally); the CLI wraps it; the FastAPI service serves it; the web app fronts the service (the human comparator's vote surface). The setup effort builds the skeleton only — the core library is the PRODUCT effort's first increment, born after setup completes. Data plane = pure logic: stateless scoring/ranking core, votes are data in/out, no DB at birth (persistence is a service-tier design ruling for the product effort). Build system = Makefile floor (dev/test/lint — the hikari idiom; room for service targets later). CI = deferred: prioritree is a GitHub project; CI is determined later — git hooks and local gates stand in at birth.", "status": "ruled"}
amendments.why: junro route-op provenance stamp (design-spec §6: every route op stamps actor, timestamp, and arguments into the route's amendments)

amendments.what: add-ruling {"question": "Q-harness", "resolution": "Full kumi grammar: the 13 seats with base packs (builtins disabled, closed-world deny, shinko primary), emitted from hikari's shared scaffold core as --target prioritree — a third TargetSpec + a prioritree-seats.yaml adapter + the ruled goal line; the fixed five engines verbatim; none of hikari's domain tools ride.", "ruling": "HARNESS (collaborator ruling 2026-11-19): Full kumi grammar at birth — the 13 seats via opencode (shinko the primary convenor, the rest subagents), builtins disabled, the closed-world deny derived from the packs. Base packs only: read/glob/grep/calculate/friction/test on every seat; patch+curate at jikko (the one mutation verb + its governed form); junro+task at shinko (the convenor holds the effort's records); keikaku holds the composition-lane route ops per Q-SEATS-1. NONE of hikari's domain plane rides: no hikari_* MCP pins, no etl/docker/git/regen/content-query — earnable by future rulings at real gates. EMISSION: from hikari's shared scaffold core (scripts/generation/clarity_scaffold.py) as --target prioritree — a third TargetSpec (root path, adapter, goal line, law block, hook bypass) + a prioritree-seats.yaml adapter at scripts/generation/sources/ (structural facts only — pack rows, verb lines, the family identities, the ruled goal line); the emission: opencode.json (13 seat blocks), AGENTS.md (@generated + the goal line), .opencode/ (package.json pins, tsconfig, the empty-return-detector plugin, THE FIXED FIVE engines verbatim — friction_ledger.py, patch.py, test_runner.py, calculate.py, curate.py — and the 13 seat prompts), .githooks/pre-commit. THE GOAL LINE (ruled this session): \"To produce superior orderings from pairwise comparison: where humans and LLMs discern the difference between two items far better than they can size either one, Priori-tree stores those judgments as votes and tallies them into a ranked whole.\" ONE NAMED DISCOVERY QUESTION rides the composition: the sibling emission's tool-registration mechanism (kepric-input carries the engines + permission keys but no visible tools/ wrappers — a discovery step must confirm the registration path before the harness increment lands).", "status": "ruled"}
amendments.why: junro route-op provenance stamp (design-spec §6: every route op stamps actor, timestamp, and arguments into the route's amendments)

amendments.what: add-question {"question": "Q-tool-registration", "text": "How does the kumi emission's tool registration work at the sibling trees — kepric-input carries the fixed-five engines at .opencode/scripts/ (friction_ledger.py, patch.py, test_runner.py, calculate.py, curate.py) and the opencode.json permission keys (calculate/curate/patch/friction/test) but no visible tools/ wrappers: what mechanism makes those engines callable as those tool ids (opencode's plugin/auto-discovery surface), and what must the prioritree emission carry so the fixed five actually register and answer? THE RULED CARRY (Q-harness's ruling, 2026-11-19): a discovery step must confirm the registration path BEFORE the harness emission lands — it rides build/harness's pipeline (the discover leg), and G-HARNESS holds the live proof (a verbatim tool call at a prioritree seat)."}
amendments.why: junro route-op provenance stamp (design-spec §6: every route op stamps actor, timestamp, and arguments into the route's amendments)

amendments.what: add-question {"question": "Q-typecheck-alignment", "text": "The type-check alignment between the ruled foundations (ruff + mypy config — the banked setup shape) and the family pre-commit template's check (uv run pyright on staged .py, the 0-errors-AND-0-warnings bar, the strictness flags riding the tree's own pyproject): does prioritree (a) adopt pyright as its checker so the family hook lands as-is, (b) carry both (mypy the tree's own instrument, pyright the hook's engine in the dev deps), or (c) parameterize the hook's check per-target in the TargetSpec (the scaffold's own \"a per-target phase ruling is a future template change\" lane)? Measured datum: the sibling kepric-input carries NEITHER (ruff + pytest only, no type checker in pyproject) — the family has no resolved precedent at the derived trees. The harness emission writes .githooks/pre-commit, so the ruling lands BEFORE the emission fires — the harness unit's brief gate (G-HARNESS-BRIEF) is the natural checkpoint."}

open_questions.question: What is prioritree — the product's core mechanism and purpose?

rulings.text: PURPOSE (collaborator ruling 2026-11-19, verbatim): "Priori-tree is a generalized prioritization system based on the concept that LLM and Humans are great at discerning the difference between two items but not great at sizing an item. That is a simplification. Consider: a human is great at determining that a basketball is larger than a grapefruit. But not great as identifying the exact dimensions of a grapefruit or a basketball. By taking a list and running through the pairwise permutations for any given comparision operator. Storing the votes, then tallying. we get a list out that is in a superior order than trying to size individual items." The comparator class is both human AND LLM — both vote through the same vote interface; the tally is a pure function of the stored votes.

open_questions.resolution: Priori-tree is a generalized prioritization system: for any list and comparison operator, run the pairwise permutations, store the votes, tally — the output list is in a superior order than sizing individual items, because discernment between two items is easy (for humans and LLMs) while absolute sizing is not.

open_questions.question: What form, data plane, build system, and CI does prioritree's setup carry at birth?

rulings.text: SETUP ARCHITECTURE (collaborator ruling 2026-11-19): Primary form = ALL FOUR — Python library, CLI tool, API service (FastAPI), web app — one layered architecture, library-first: src/prioritree carries the pure-logic core (items, comparison operator, pair scheduling, votes, tally); the CLI wraps it; the FastAPI service serves it; the web app fronts the service (the human comparator's vote surface). The setup effort builds the skeleton only — the core library is the PRODUCT effort's first increment, born after setup completes. Data plane = pure logic: stateless scoring/ranking core, votes are data in/out, no DB at birth (persistence is a service-tier design ruling for the product effort). Build system = Makefile floor (dev/test/lint — the hikari idiom; room for service targets later). CI = deferred: prioritree is a GitHub project; CI is determined later — git hooks and local gates stand in at birth.

open_questions.resolution: All four forms layered library-first: the src/prioritree pure-logic core at the bottom, CLI over it, FastAPI service over that, web app on top — the setup builds the skeleton and the core library is the product effort's first increment. Pure logic at birth (no DB); Makefile floor (dev/test/lint); GitHub project, CI determined later.

rulings.text: HARNESS (collaborator ruling 2026-11-19): Full kumi grammar at birth — the 13 seats via opencode (shinko the primary convenor, the rest subagents), builtins disabled, the closed-world deny derived from the packs. Base packs only: read/glob/grep/calculate/friction/test on every seat; patch+curate at jikko (the one mutation verb + its governed form); junro+task at shinko (the convenor holds the effort's records); keikaku holds the composition-lane route ops per Q-SEATS-1. NONE of hikari's domain plane rides: no hikari_* MCP pins, no etl/docker/git/regen/content-query — earnable by future rulings at real gates. EMISSION: from hikari's shared scaffold core (scripts/generation/clarity_scaffold.py) as --target prioritree — a third TargetSpec (root path, adapter, goal line, law block, hook bypass) + a prioritree-seats.yaml adapter at scripts/generation/sources/ (structural facts only — pack rows, verb lines, the family identities, the ruled goal line); the emission: opencode.json (13 seat blocks), AGENTS.md (@generated + the goal line), .opencode/ (package.json pins, tsconfig, the empty-return-detector plugin, THE FIXED FIVE engines verbatim — friction_ledger.py, patch.py, test_runner.py, calculate.py, curate.py — and the 13 seat prompts), .githooks/pre-commit. THE GOAL LINE (ruled this session): "To produce superior orderings from pairwise comparison: where humans and LLMs discern the difference between two items far better than they can size either one, Priori-tree stores those judgments as votes and tallies them into a ranked whole." ONE NAMED DISCOVERY QUESTION rides the composition: the sibling emission's tool-registration mechanism (kepric-input carries the engines + permission keys but no visible tools/ wrappers — a discovery step must confirm the registration path before the harness increment lands).
